spanish: Y a estos se impurificarán; todo el tocante en su cadáver se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: «todo el» plus a singular noun can mean one whole toucher; כָּל with the definite participle is whoever touches.
In current Latin American Spanish «tarde» often means afternoon and does not securely mark evening.

notes: 2mp hithpael matches the ustedes future; qal 3ms stays singular becoming-unclean.
